**Which financial data management tools is the business using? These tools are related to obtaining, storing and reviewing the business financial data.**

**Which human resources mangement tools is the business using? These tools are related to streamlining communication and company-employee relations.**

**Which customer relationship management tools is the business using? These tools are related to obtaining the order history for each customer, collaboration with customers is done using a digital system.**

**Which resources management tools is the business using? These tools are related to the access of data about asset management (raw materials, inventory, financial resources, etc.)  from current digital systems.**

**Which communication and customer relations tools is the business using? These tools are related to the access of online data based on keywords entered into search engines.**

**Which processess digitalization tools is the business using? These tools are related to the digitalization of the processes within the business.**

**Which security policy tools is the business using? These tools are related to the ability to quickly recover access to data in the event of its loss.**

**Which production digitalization tools is the business using? These tools are related to the automation/informatization/digitalization of the business production (does not apply to non-manufacturing applicants).**
